historical_notes_partial.structural_scope: All level-two headings indexed; selected complete status/remediation/completeness sections and authorization tail read. No every-row/generated/formula/log review claimed.
historical_notes_partial.review_scope: Historical predecessor working notes: selected substantive sections only. Remaining prose/field lists/live examples unreviewed; later fully read initial/remediation/blueprint/pass2 task and decision documents govern current dispositions.
historical_notes_partial.continuation_priority: Lower-value historical precursor; retain exact remaining body, no blanket completion.

priority_rules: Unique current tasklists/PRDs/owner decisions and contradictory closure receipts first.
Prior full cron decisions reused at exact hashes; do not repeat them without advancement.
Historical March field inventories/test logs/family receipts remain mapped support. Do not read every unchanged log as a new task source.
The long first-pass notes file is substantive historical prose and partially read, not a generated-file full-coverage claim.
Advanced live coordination is unreviewed unless an exact later read is recorded.
